_about: Overworld requirements audit (tools/rando/parity/audit_overworld.py). One entry per place where OoTR's rule is looser than the remake. Every rule is OoTR's own rule with the remake's extra condition added (never a weaker one), except grotto entrances whose lid the remake changed: there the lid's real opener replaces OoTR's (storm lid -> can_open_storm_grotto, bomb lid -> can_open_bomb_grotto or here(can_blast_or_smash)), keeping OoTR's Stone of Agony convention. This file sorts first among data/rando/logic/*.json, so a later file that sets the same key would replace it: no key below is set by another logic file (checked against chests, dungeons, drops, shops, songs_trade, story, audit_dungeons, grotto pass included). The reason for each entry is under _why (logic_overrides reads only helpers/regions/new_regions/new_locations). OotrR study (matched against the game-side fixes): entries marked UNPROVEN take the AND of OoTR's rule and OotrR's until an in-game check; 'NOT CHANGED' entries record a study finding the files contradict.

_why.Root Exits | exits | Requiem of Spirit W: HIGH (other randomizers' study: Barajador, Kaepora seen in game). The remake has no save warp and autosaves on arrival, so a warp song that lands where Link can't walk out strands him for good. Requiem's pad (Desert Colossus): neither age walks back, OoTR's own Wasteland Near Colossus -> Wasteland Near Crate is the logic_reverse_wasteland trick. Bolero's pad (DMC Central Local): the child can't leave the crater's centre (in game; OoTR's DMC Central Local exits are adult-only), the adult leaves with Hover Boots, Hookshot or pre-planted beans (OoTR's DMC Central Local -> DMC Lower/Upper Nearby; a bean planted there needs a child who can't get back). So logic counts these warps only with a way out: that adult route (Bolero) or another warp song whose pad leads home (Minuet: Sacred Forest Meadow; Serenade: Lake Hylia; Nocturne: the graveyard ledge; Prelude: the Temple of Time). With warp_songs (shuffled destinations) the names say nothing about the pads, so OoTR's rule stands and tools/rando/no_savewarp.py decides: it now counts a warp song as a way home only when its pad leads home by walking (before, any playable warp song skipped the check). OoTR: can_play(<song>) and can_leave_forest.

The way in and back stay OoTR's (Graveyard -> grave: is_adult; grave -> Graveyard: True): parity/_chests_dampe.py exit_ops (every seed, ItZPomme's exit validated in game) makes Dampe's talk after a race send a Link without the Hookshot or Longshot back to Graveyard_Adult, and a Link with one leaves by the windmill. (Clawshot's own grave rules, Hookshot to enter and no way back, are for a game without that fix.)
